title: Fixed Split Forefoot And Heel Stretcher
description: One newly authored complete static split-forefoot and separate-heel shoe-stretcher appearance. Two individually closed sculpted wooden forefoot halves form a broad rounded toe tapering toward a narrower rear throat, with a genuine uninterrupted longitudinal split above and ahead of their hidden fixed cross connector. An independent rounded heel block stands behind a true open interval; a complete longitudinal metal spindle joins the forefoot connector through the heel and extends to an intact transverse turning handle. Two finite collars and a short heel-side guide visibly distinguish the rod/block junction. No old shoe-last anvil, tripod, vise or imported mesh used. Unlike the old one-piece shoe-shaped metal head atop a stem and tripod, this is a low internal-form-style split forefoot, separated heel and long back screw appearance; unlike the clamp-on bench vise, no C-clamp or flat opposed jaw pair. All geometry newly authored. One prop, zero scenes, four opaque untextured PBR roles. Static visual overlaps are not a validated screw/expansion mechanism. No shoe, foot, human, fit, size, stretching action, forces, mechanical travel, manufacturing or safety performance. Rigging, animation and interaction not made and outside scope.
